p: meditation: That is, my vehement prayer and secret complaint and sighings.
look up: Or wait, with patience and trust till I am heard.
wickedness: Seeing that God of nature hates wickedness, he must punish the wicked and save the godly.
The foolish shall not stand in: Who run blindly after their carnal desires.
will come into thy house in: In the deepest of his temptations he puts his full confidence in God.
because of mine enemies: Because you are just, therefore lead me out of the dangers of my enemies.
fall by their own counsels: Let their devices come to nothing.
let all those that put their: Your favour toward me will confirm the faith of all others.
wilt thou compass him as with: So that he will be safe from all dangers.
